findings.claim: test_docs_readme_says_the_template_offers_the_reviewer asserts that "agents/adversarial-reviewer.md\n" is not in the section after collapsing all whitespace to single spaces, so the section can never hold a newline and the assertion always passes. It does not catch the old .md entry coming back. Drop the "\n" (for example, check that "agents/adversarial-reviewer.md " or "/adversarial-reviewer.md`" is absent) or check the yaml snippet line itself.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.
With the default answer, AGENTS.md gets the adversarial-reviews rule word for word from jasperhg90/skills at 41f49502.
apm.yml gets the pinned `.agent.md` entry only when claude is a harness.
Answering false writes neither.
The .gitignore holds every listed path and none of the committed ones.
The docs match the change.
One test assertion is vacuous, and a plain fix is enough, so the verdict is fix.
Ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and integration all passed, and so did eval rows r1 to r7.
Result: "stamp green: b557d3ecf85e0e6cadaf0b57f0a44ba7ee9615677a01ae8fc0122f0957010cd4".
Fetched rules/adversarial-reviews.instructions.md at 41f495021f3b264992c8fa764d58565c1184ab91 with `gh api` and compared it to the constraint block in starter/AGENTS.md.jinja.
They match exactly.
Rendered the template by hand (defaults with a description, and adversarial_review=false).
The section's spacing is right, apm.yml parses with the comment inside the list, and the off render leaves AGENTS.md without the section.
Rows: r1 checks four phrases from the rule and that the answer is `True`.
r2 checks `deps[1:]` exactly against `[REVIEWER]` or `[]` for every harness set, so a missing entry, an unpinned one or one pinned to another commit fails.
r3 checks the whole dependency list and that "adversarial" is absent from AGENTS.md.
r4 runs `git check-ignore --no-index` and compares the results as sets in both directions.
r5 adds the `.claude/agents/adversarial-reviewer.md` check to the bootstrap test, which renders with the defaults for all three harnesses.
r6 covers the how-to table and the README section.
Each test fails when its row's `fails_when` happens.
Loosening `test_render_writes_the_project_pinned_to_this_release` to `[0]` loses nothing, because the r2 and r3 tests pin the full list.
Consistency: the copier help, the how-to rows and the README agree with the plan and with ADR 0024 (OpenCode skips the Claude-format copy, Antigravity gets nothing).
The manifesto and overview describe the starter at a level this change does not make false.
f1 (test-strength, non-blocking): the `"agents/adversarial-reviewer.md\n" not in section` check in the README docs test can never fail, because the section's whitespace was already collapsed.
The other two assertions in that test do work.
